claim: Wall cstat 32 (one-way) cuts the renderer's sector flood but not movement: clipmove tests only bit 0, so a body walks through a one-way wall unless bit 0 is set too. The cut is directional: the flag lives on one of the two coincident walls and stops only views that start on its own side.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/include/buildtypes.h:154 CSTAT_WALL_1WAY = 1<<5; build.h:225 CLIPMASK0 is bits 0 and 16; clip.cpp:1626 tests wal->cstat & dawalclipmask

Functions: clip.cpp:1626 is in clipmove; the flood test is engine.cpp:4914 in classicDrawBunches (!(wal->cstat&32) on the near sector's own wall); Blood moves bodies with CLIPMASK0 (actor.cpp:4275 MoveThing, :4470 MoveDude).
use: Flag both walls of a pair to cut visibility both ways; set bit 0 as well only where a body must be stopped. overlap_visibility reads the flood as a directed graph.

checked.how: buildtypes.h:154 CSTAT_WALL_1WAY = 1u<<5u; build.h:225 CLIPMASK0 = (1<<16)+1; clip.cpp:1626 in clipmove tests wal->cstat & dawalclipmask; actor.cpp:4275/4470 MoveThing/MoveDude ClipMove with CLIPMASK0. engine.cpp:4914 (classicDrawBunches) floods to nextsectnum only if !(wal->cstat&32), the wall of the sector being drawn: one-sided as claimed.
